newsitem.title: USA: HUGHES SEEKS $4 BLN IN SATELLITE DEALS - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: HUGHES SEEKS $4 BLN IN SATELLITE DEALS - WSJ.

text.p: Hughes Electronic Corp , a unit of General Motors Corp , is pursuing two satellite deals with a combined potential price tag of nearly $4 billion, The Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The purchases, if completed, would make Hughes a global force in satellite broadcasting.

Hughes is the leading contender to acquire control of PanAmSat Corp , the world's leading privately held satellite system, in a complex deal that could be valued at as much as $3 billion, people familiar with the developments told the newspaper.
Hughes also has been in serious talks to invest as much as $1 billion for a 30-percent stake in the Netherlands' NetHold.
It is a holding company controlled by South African financier Johann Rupert. NetHold is half owned by Richemont Securities AG , with the balance held by MCL-Multi Choice Ltd.

The two moves highlight the long-term strategy of Hughes to expand its general broadcast and direct-to-home satellite television systems into global networks. Hughes' own DirecTV service has more than 1.5 million subscribers in the United States.
The telecommunications and aerospace concern has established its foothold in Latin America with a joint venture there and is planning a joint venture in Japan.
